gen-dafont-dogica-gf-amiko: Wide, heavy, blunt letters from Dogica take the heading, while Amiko follows with tall, modern strokes and terminals that flare outward. Give Amiko a generous size.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-bangla: Dogica's widely tracked, heavy lettering announces itself before anything else on the page. It commands attention up top, and Anek Bangla, with its wide, barely curled s curves, does the quiet work of being approachable below.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-devanagari: Commanding, that's Dogica, with lowercase rising nearly to capital height and curves left clearly open at their ends. Anek Devanagari answers its weight with a tall middle zone and open mouths, modern and level-headed.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-gujarati: Anek Gujarati has lowercase that rivals its capitals and a gaping c. Dogica earns its keep as a big, short, heavy heading, its wide tracking giving every word room to announce itself.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi reads clean and businesslike, with big open counters throughout. Dogica brings the weight and wide tracking on top, so the two feel like a loud voice paired with a patient one.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-kannada: Dogica's lowercase climbs almost to capital height, and it's spaced out wide. Anek Kannada is the counterweight, its tall x-height and far-flung terminals keeping the contemporary text feeling crisp.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-latin: Dogica spaces its heavy letters out wide, with every curve left open at the end. Anek Latin follows with tall lowercase nearly matching its capitals, a plain sans that holds its shapes open rather than curled shut.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam reads clean and contemporary, with barely any gap between x-height and caps. Anek Malayalam's curve tips never touch, which gives Dogica's heavy, wide-set heading a lighter partner underneath.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-odia: Clean is the mood Anek Odia brings, with unlatched rounds and capitals barely above lowercase. Anek Odia then carries a long stretch of text smoothly beneath Dogica's heavy, widely tracked heading.
gen-dafont-dogica-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil comes in modern and round, with big lowercase bowls and half-unwrapped c and s shapes. Anek Tamil's openness is what stands out against Dogica's heavy, commanding, wide-tracked heading.
